correctness.rationale: The proof establishes the uniform lower bound from z<=2t, exhausts equality-label counts for every residue, classifies all cyclic gaps using saturation, proves each candidate satisfies the complement requirement, and gives bijective labelled and dihedral counts. Special cycles 3,4,5 are separate finite cases, and a direct fully enumerative verifier handles n=3..12 plus constructive checks for n=6..80. Finite tests corroborate but do not prove the unrestricted theorem.

value.rationale: The primary motivating global Roman literature studies complexity rather than explicit extremizer enumeration. A natural, complete infinite-family classification of the minimum configurations and their symmetry classes answers a more refined exact question than the classical numerical minimum. Its n=3m+2 branch has polynomially increasing labelled multiplicity but only floor(m/2)+2 dihedral types, explaining the asymmetry of exact optimal configurations. These are intrinsic natural invariants rather than arbitrary finite slices.
